scope: Every API call in apps/web and apps/admin compared with the registered route table (generated API client, kept in sync by check:api-client)
Storefront calls to routes whose access changed during P02-P13
Cross-module guest purchase journey over HTTP (cart, checkout, payment confirmation, order, stock)

route_reconciliation.notes: Paths not found in the route table were the storefront's own Next.js routes (/api/auth/sync, /api/auth/clear) and a page link (/sign-in). Detection covers calls with literal or template-string paths; calls built from variables are not detected.

reviewed_without_change: The storefront and admin only call routes their users may use after the audit's role changes (admin users are ADMIN; storefront customer calls all target customer-allowed routes).
Completing a checkout with an unconfirmed or made-up payment creates no order, moves no stock and leaves the checkout open (P06 rules verified end to end over HTTP).

findings.problem: POST /checkout/:id/complete marked a customer's checkout completed without verifying any payment or creating an order (the payment id was ignored). Neither frontend uses it; a client calling it after paying would leave the customer charged with no order and a checkout that could no longer be completed.
findings.change: The route is admin-only (closing a checkout without an order); customers complete checkouts with /complete-with-order. Staff closing bypasses the customer ownership rule explicitly.
findings.verification: E2E: baseline a guest and a customer closed their checkout without payment (200); fixed 401/403, admin close 200.

findings.problem: The storefront kept unused helpers for creating orders directly and redeeming loyalty points, routes now reserved for staff (orders are created and points redeemed by checkout).
findings.verification: No remaining references; storefront type-check passes and its lint results are unchanged (6 pre-existing problems).

tests.new: E2E guest-purchase-journey (1); cart E2E checkout case now checks customer refusal and admin close
tests.baseline: Both cases failed against the previous code (checkout closed without payment).
tests.database_suites: All E2E and integration suites: 173 tests in 51 files pass
tests.final: 1547 unit tests in 122 files; root/tooling tsc; 7/7 workspace type-checks (forced); cart ESLint (no errors); API client check passes; route reconciliation 187/187 calls matched

follow_ups: A full HTTP purchase with a confirmed Stripe payment needs a Stripe test-mode key or an injectable payment confirmation in the server factory; it is covered at the persistence level by the CheckoutCompletion integration suite.
Route reconciliation does not see paths built from variables; a typed client for all storefront calls (packages/api-client) would make this check exhaustive.
